x: There was another long gap until Tom Dowdall closed in the 'A' team in 189th. With the team 20th from 54 we were not too disappointed but could do so much better.
After a fast downhill start Jim Rimmer led the Belgrave team followed by Alan Black, Leo Coy, Simon Holmes and Tom Dowdall - having a real 'blinder'.

Further down the field Tom Dowdall proved his earlier victory over Brian Gorman was no fluke - but only by 2 seconds. Leo Coy seems to be having a rough patch at the moment but no doubt is holding back for the big races later in the season.

Tom Dowdall and David Searle made the most of their opportunity to get into the scoring six but with a 1513 points total to give 28th place the continuing saga of unsatisfactory Southern Championship results.

A special mention too for Tom 'Jimmy' Dowdall's fighting run in the 'B' steeplechase. As the match neared the end we moved into second team place - an unthought of possibility a couple of hours earlier - but we couldn't quite maintain it to the end.
Alan Black who returned to win the club s/chase is closely shadowed by the ubiquitous Tom Dowdall

Mark Shippen made a welcome return to finish 2nd in the pole-vault and Tom Dowdall ran himself into the ground to set a p.b. 3000 s.c. Ex field events Captain John Martin travelled from Swindon to help out and in the open 1500m John Gladwin ran a 4.02.0 time trial to demonstrate that his leg injury had healed.
